statusNote: Selection for 2026 is complete; the 2026 page does not state a compensation amount.
summary: The Igalia Coding Experience is a grant program for people studying Computer Science, Information Technology or Free Software, formally or self-taught. Participants get their first professional experience working hand in hand with Igalia programmers.

stipend.detail: Compensation for the 2025 program was €7,000 for 450 hours. Igalia's 2026 page does not publish an amount.

facts.label: 2026 areas
facts.value: Linux packaging, Graphics (Mesa), JavaScript devtools, Multimedia and GStreamer, Web standards

eligibility: People learning and wanting initial professional experience in free/open source development: students or self-learners.
Also open to people later in their career who want to move into computer science.
Igalia expressly invites women (cis and trans), trans men and genderqueer people, and prioritizes applicants from groups underrepresented in technology.
Previous free software contributions help but are not required.

timeline.label: Start
timeline.date: From June 2026, finishing before the end of 2026

howToApply: Choose one or more areas listed on the Coding Experience page.
Fill in the application form with a cover letter and a CV (PDF).
Selected participants agree a start date with Igalia.
